title: Instructions hidden in log fields, measuring prompt injection against a local security assistant and two detector informed defences
description: Code and aggregated results of the study "Instructions hidden in log fields, measuring prompt injection against a local security assistant and two detector informed defences", a follow on study of the SentinelSphere platform carried out under the Horizon Europe project ResilMesh, Grant Agreement No. 101119681. The repository holds the analysis code, the result tables and the figures of the Open Research Europe article. Third party datasets and benchmark items are not included.
